Delhi Woman Receives Rs 200 Crore Extortion Threat Claiming Goldy Brar Connection

A woman in Delhi received a WhatsApp threat demanding Rs 200 crore, with the caller claiming to be Goldy Brar. The incident was reported by multiple outlets, highlighting the extortion demand and the alleged connection to the fugitive gangster. The threat was delivered via WhatsApp, specifying the large sum of money sought.
